intent.zh: 确认研发变更受控、版本与样机/批次可双向追溯
intent.en: Ensure engineering changes are controlled and versions are bi-directionally traceable with prototypes and batches.

questions.id: change-需求-设计变更是否执行-ecr-ecn-流程并进行成本-进度-质量影响评估

text.zh: 需求/设计变更是否执行 ECR→ECN 流程并进行成本/进度/质量影响评估？
text.en: Do requirements/design changes follow the ECR→ECN process with cost, schedule, and quality impact assessments?

zh.1: 无正式 ECR/ECN 流程，变更记录缺失。
zh.2: 有流程但执行零散，影响评估模板不完整。
zh.3: ECR→ECN 流程运行，影响评估与审批记录完整。
zh.4: 评估结论与验证计划闭环，实施状态可追溯。
zh.5: 变更流程与项目系统集成，影响数据实时分析与预警。

en.1: No formal ECR/ECN process and change records are missing.
en.2: Process exists but execution is ad-hoc with incomplete impact assessment templates.
en.3: ECR→ECN process executes with complete impact assessments and approval records.
en.4: Assessment conclusions and validation plans are closed with traceable implementation status.
en.5: Change process integrates with the project system, providing real-time impact analytics and alerts.

focus: 端到端流程阶段与交付物
ask: 影响评估包含哪些输入？
ECN 实施状态如何追踪？
NPI 流程的关键 Gate 是哪些？
Entry/Exit 判定如何落地？
evidence: 阶段评审纪要与交付物清单
threshold: 所有变更均完成影响评估与验证闭环
端到端流程文件化并执行
关键 Gate 结果可追溯

ask: What inputs are covered in the impact assessment?
How is ECN implementation status tracked?
What are the key gates in the NPI process?
How are Entry/Exit criteria enforced?
evidence: Phase review minutes and deliverable list
threshold: Every change completes impact assessment and validation closure
End-to-end process is documented and executed

questions.id: change-bom-图纸-固件是否在-plm-alm-中实现单一数据源与权限控制

text.zh: BOM/图纸/固件是否在 PLM/ALM 中实现单一数据源与权限控制？
text.en: Do BOMs, drawings, and firmware use a single source of truth with access control in PLM/ALM?

zh.1: BOM/图纸/固件分散管理，缺乏权限控制。
zh.2: 部分资料入库但版本控制不一致。
zh.3: 在 PLM/ALM 中维护单一数据源并设定权限。
zh.4: 版本更替有审批轨迹，与制造/供应链同步。
zh.5: 数据主线与配置管理系统打通，自动同步并可审计。

en.1: BOMs, drawings, and firmware are managed separately with no access control.
en.2: Some data is stored but version control is inconsistent.
en.3: A single source is maintained in PLM/ALM with defined permissions.
en.4: Version changes have approval traces and stay in sync with manufacturing and supply chain.
en.5: Data backbone links with configuration management, syncing automatically with auditability.

ask: 资料如何纳入 PLM/ALM？
权限与版本如何审批？
threshold: 关键数据在系统中受控且版本可追溯

focus: Single source of truth in PLM/ALM
ask: How is data ingested into PLM/ALM?
How are permissions and versions approved?
threshold: Critical data is controlled with traceable versions in the system

questions.id: change-样机-批次与版本是否可双向追溯-where-used-as-built

text.zh: 样机/批次与版本是否可双向追溯（Where Used/As-built）？
text.en: Can prototypes/batches trace versions bi-directionally (Where Used/As-built)?

zh.1: 样机或批次无法追溯所用版本。
zh.2: 存在零散追溯记录，查询效率低。
zh.3: 建立双向追溯台账，可关联主要样机与版本。
zh.4: 追溯信息实时更新，支持快速定位影响范围。
zh.5: 追溯系统可视化，支持逆向分析与批量预警。

en.1: Prototypes or batches cannot trace the versions used.
en.2: Traceability records exist but are scattered and inefficient.
en.3: Bi-directional trace ledger links key prototypes to versions.
en.4: Traceability updates in real time to quickly identify impact scope.
en.5: Traceability system is visualized, enabling reverse analysis and batch alerts.

focus: 样机/批次与版本对应关系
ask: 如何快速定位受影响样机？
数据是否实时更新？
threshold: 样机与版本双向追溯可在系统中完成

ask: How do we quickly identify affected prototypes?
Is the data updated in real time?
threshold: Bi-directional traceability between prototypes and versions is available in the system

questions.id: change-对客户-生产-供应商的-pcn-scn-通知机制是否明确且可审计

text.zh: 对客户/生产/供应商的 PCN/SCN 通知机制是否明确且可审计？
text.en: Is the PCN/SCN notification process to customers, manufacturing, and suppliers defined and auditable?

zh.1: 无 PCN/SCN 通知机制，沟通多靠口头。
zh.2: 有通知流程但责任与时限不明确。
zh.3: 建立通知流程与记录，能对关键方进行确认。
zh.4: 通知包含影响评估与应对计划，全链路可追溯。
zh.5: 通知流程数字化，与供应商/客户系统对接并自动提醒。

en.1: No PCN/SCN notification mechanism; communication is mostly verbal.
en.2: Notification process exists but responsibilities and timelines are unclear.
en.3: Notification process and records exist with confirmation from key parties.
en.4: Notifications include impact assessments and mitigation plans with full traceability.
en.5: Notification process is digital, interfacing with supplier/customer systems with automatic reminders.

focus: 产能/交期/生命周期评估
客户/法规输入感知机制
ask: ESI 包含哪些关键评估？
评估结果如何反馈给设计？
通知流程如何触发？
如何确认对方已收到并执行？
外部输入如何捕获并派发？
影响评估包含哪些维度？
threshold: 产能/生命周期评估完成并落实约束
关键通知留痕并可审计
关键外部输入均评估并形成验证计划

ask: What evaluations are covered in ESI?
How are assessment results fed back into design?
How is the notification process triggered?
How do we confirm recipients have received and acted?
How are external inputs captured and dispatched?
Which dimensions are covered in the impact assessment?
threshold: Capacity and lifecycle assessments are completed with constraints applied
Critical notifications are logged and auditable
All critical external inputs are assessed with validation plans
